covers_menu.title: Covers
covers_menu.description: The covers opened and closed every day, their times, and heat protection.

menu_option_descriptions.daily_cover_schedule: Opening by day mode · closing tonight at {close_at}

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: The work calendar decides the working days and their events; the holiday calendar switches the day to the holiday mode.
calendars.submit: Save and back to the menu

mapping.title: Day modes
mapping.description: Choose the mode applied for each kind of day. The display names are folded further down.

data_description.mode_absence: Picking this mode yourself pauses the automatic updates until you leave it. A calendar event mapped to this mode pauses nothing.
data_description.event_mode_map: An event whose title contains the keyword switches the day to that mode. The value is the mode key: home, work, remote or away.

day_modes_section.name: Day mode display names
day_modes_section.description: The name shown for each mode. The technical key never changes.

data_description.day_display_home: Display name for the home key
data_description.day_display_work: Display name for the work key
data_description.day_display_remote: Display name for the remote key
data_description.day_display_away: Display name for the away key

data_description.thermostat_display_off: Display name for the off key
data_description.thermostat_display_heating: Display name for the heating key
data_description.thermostat_display_cooling: Display name for the cooling key
data_description.thermostat_display_ventilation: Display name for the ventilation key

mapping.submit: Save and back to the menu

schedulers.title: Schedulers
schedulers.description: The schedulers of the active mode are turned on, those of every other mode are turned off. Open a mode to edit its list.
schedulers.submit: Save and back to the menu

covers.title: Heat protection
covers.description: Closes the chosen covers when it gets too hot. Protection only acts between the opening and closing times computed under “Opening and closing times”: set those first.

data_description.cover_entities: Separate from the managed covers: a cover can be protected from heat without following the daily times. Once closed by the heat, it stays closed until the next normal opening or the evening close.

data_description.cover_temp_threshold: The covers close once the sensor goes above this temperature.
data_description.cover_weather_entity: Optional. When today's forecast high is above the forecast threshold, the covers close from the opening time on, without waiting for the sensor.
data_description.cover_forecast_threshold: Forecast high above which the early close triggers.

data_description.cover_my_button: When set, this button is pressed instead of the action below.
data_description.cover_action: “Close” sends close_cover. “Stop” sends stop_cover, which interrupts the current movement: useful for Somfy RTS covers.

daily_cover_schedule.title: Opening and closing times
daily_cover_schedule.description:
Applies to the covers listed under “Managed covers”.

**At {close_elevation}°, the covers will close at {close_at_elevation} tonight.**

close_section.name: Evening close
close_section.description: Once a day, for every mode, when the sun goes below this elevation.

data.close_when_window_shuts: Close as soon as the window is shut

data_description.daily_cover_close_elevation: 0° = sunset, -2° (recommended) ≈ ten minutes later, -4° ≈ twenty to twenty-five minutes later, -6° = end of civil twilight. A positive value closes before sunset.
data_description.close_when_window_shuts: A cover left up in the evening because its window was open closes (or goes to its My position) as soon as the window is shut, until the next morning's opening.

open_section.name: Morning opening
open_section.description: For each mode: at sunrise, no opening, or a fixed HH:MM time. Modes set the same way open together.

data_description.sunrise_earliest: At sunrise, the covers open no earlier than this time.

cover_items.title: Managed covers
cover_items.description:
The covers opened and closed every day; a cover group counts as one. In the evening, a cover whose window is reported open is not closed and a warning is logged.

{covers}

menu_option_descriptions.cover_item_add: With, if needed, a window sensor and a My button
menu_option_descriptions.cover_item_pick: Change its window sensor or My button
menu_option_descriptions.cover_item_remove: Remove them from HomeShift, leaving the entities alone

cover_item_add.title: Add a cover
cover_item_add.description: Choose the cover and, if needed, its window sensor and its favourite position button.

data_description.cover: The cover to open and close on the daily times.
data_description.window_sensor: Binary sensor that is 'on' while the window is open. Window open at the evening close: the cover is not closed and a warning is logged. With “Close as soon as the window is shut” (opening and closing times), it closes once the window is shut.
data_description.my_button: For a cover that must not close fully: the evening close presses this button instead of closing the cover.

cover_item_add.submit: Save and back to the list

cover_item_edit.title: Edit a cover
cover_item_edit.description: Cover: **{cover}**. Clear a field to remove the sensor or the button.

data_description.window_sensor: Binary sensor that is 'on' while the window is open. Window open at the evening close: the cover is not closed and a warning is logged. With “Close as soon as the window is shut” (opening and closing times), it closes once the window is shut.
data_description.my_button: For a cover that must not close fully: the evening close presses this button instead of closing the cover.

cover_item_edit.submit: Save and back to the list

cover_item_remove.title: Remove covers
cover_item_remove.description: The ticked covers are no longer opened or closed by HomeShift. The entities themselves are left alone.
cover_item_remove.submit: Save and back to the list

error.invalid_calendar: The specified calendar entity does not exist
error.elevation_unreachable: The sun does not reach this elevation every day of the year at your location. Pick a value inside the sun's yearly range — 0° is sunset, negative values are below the horizon.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HomeShift is already configured — only one instance is supported.

refresh_schedulers.name: Refresh Schedulers
refresh_schedulers.description: Refresh scheduler states based on current day mode and thermostat mode

sync_calendar.name: Sync Calendar
sync_calendar.description: Re-sync the calendar and update the current day mode

open_covers.name: Open covers
open_covers.description: Open the covers of the daily schedule now, whatever the time or the day mode.

close_covers.name: Close covers
close_covers.description: Close the covers of the daily schedule now, like the evening close: a cover behind an open window stays up, a cover with a My button goes to its My position.

inhibit_covers.name: Inhibit covers
inhibit_covers.description: Temporarily take covers out of the automation (daily open/close, heat protection and the open/close-now actions). With neither a duration nor an end date, they stay inhibited until resumed.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers to leave alone. Only the covers HomeShift drives are accepted.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the covers stay inhibited.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the inhibition ends (instead of a duration).

resume_covers.name: Resume covers
resume_covers.description: Hand inhibited covers back to the automation. They rejoin the next scheduled action; nothing moves right away.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers to resume. Leave empty to resume every inhibited cover.

cover_not_managed.message: HomeShift does not drive {covers} — only the covers of the daily schedule and of heat protection can be inhibited.

inhibition_end_in_past.message: The end of the inhibition must be in the future.
